result.summary: Found 1 issue: a duplicate restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel displays the exact same 'Green Bowl Poké' card twice in a row with identical image, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90 delivery).
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list so each venue appears only once in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.
